title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1969-08-02
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
source: flac16 Recording Info: SBD -> Master Cass -> Dat (48k)

ai_review.summary: Fair soundboard capture of a mixed‑quality show where the Other One and Hard to Handle shine despite muddiness and tape drops.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard source that sounds a bit muddy and suffers from noticeable cuts – most painfully on the ending of Lovelight. Musically the concert is uneven; fans love the scorching Other One and a jam‑filled Hard to Handle, but the setlist feels odd for ’69 with weaker moments like Slewfoot, Silver Strings and a damaged Pig’s BB Man. Overall it’s a decent snapshot of this era, though technical flaws keep it from being truly great.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews highlight strong performances on a few songs but repeatedly note muddiness and tape cuts; the show is viewed as average‑to‑good with notable highs, leading to a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Muddier than adjacent nights, a nasty cut on Pig's BB Man, and a garbled ending of Lovelight; overall decent but not pristine.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Odd for the summer ’69 tour – missing the usual DS>SS>11 sequence and featuring some rarely‑played numbers, resulting in a set that feels less cohesive despite strong jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers note his birthday appearance, steel pedal guitar work, and mediation of picket‑line hassles; praised for musical diversity on this night.
